title: Columbia TV threatens to 'burn your negative' over the Men in Black suits in the Dark Skies pilot

plain: In 1995, Columbia TV threatened to shut down the pilot of Dark Skies, a TV series about UFOs, unless its actors stopped wearing black suits, because the look clashed with the coming film Men in Black. Bryce Zabel, a writer who made the show, tells Michels the order is "seared in my head": "Get your actors out of the black suits today or we will shut down your production and burn your negative." He names the film's director Barry Sonnenfeld, Steven Spielberg and Spielberg's company Amblin in the story.
